rationale: The signal here is a single HN comment expressing generic enthusiasm for enterprise data subscriptions — there is no defined product, no validated dataset, and no specific pain articulated beyond 'companies pay for data.' The buyer (F500 strategy/CI teams) is real and does pay for data feeds, but reaching them requires an enterprise sales motion (procurement, legal, long cycles) that is incompatible with a solo non-technical operator; the underlying data asset ('quantifying median thinking') is completely undefined. Without a concrete dataset and a named buyer problem, this cannot be built or sold in any near-term timeframe, and the single-comment basis is insufficient to justify even a validation sprint.
solution_plan: No actionable build plan is possible at this stage — the product concept is undefined. If the operator wants to explore this space, the only sensible next step is to post a specific question back in the HN thread asking what data the commenter actually wants to buy and at what price point, then aggregate any replies into a concrete problem statement before revisiting. A solo non-technical operator cannot build a defensible enterprise data subscription product without first knowing what the data is.
